runtime/pem#

The native layer under crypto/x509/trust, encoding/pem: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under crypto/x509/trust, encoding/pem: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable strict textual PEM boundary for encoding/pem.
